title: Marlowe Rewards Tier Thresholds and Status Validity Schedule
content:
Each Marlowe Rewards tier is reached on calendar-year qualifying spend. The threshold below is the qualifying spend, in US dollars, at which the tier is reached; spend at or above the figure meets it, and spend below it does not.

## Schedule by tier

| Tier | Calendar-year qualifying spend at which the tier is reached | Most tier levels a membership can fall at one annual tier review | Calendar years after the qualifying year through whose 31 December a reached tier stays valid | Annual tier review date | Minimum age at enrolment |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Marlowe Rewards Member | 0.00 | 1 | 1 | 1 January (01-01) | 192 calendar months |
| Marlowe Rewards Silver | 350.00 | 1 | 1 | 1 January (01-01) | 192 calendar months |
| Marlowe Rewards Gold | 750.00 | 1 | 1 | 1 January (01-01) | 192 calendar months |
| Marlowe Rewards Platinum | 1500.00 | 1 | 1 | 1 January (01-01) | 192 calendar months |
| Marlowe Rewards Icon | 3000.00 | 1 | 1 | 1 January (01-01) | 192 calendar months |
| Marlowe Rewards Atelier | 6000.00 | 1 | 1 | 1 January (01-01) | 192 calendar months |

## Notes to the schedule

- **Thresholds.** The figure is the tier's entry threshold, stated to the cent. Marlowe Rewards Member has a threshold of 0.00: every membership holds at least that tier.
- **Levels down at a review.** At one annual tier review a membership falls by no more than one tier level, whatever its spend.
- **Validity.** A reached tier stays valid through 31 December of the calendar year that comes one year after the year in which it was reached.
- **Review date.** The annual tier review takes place on 1 January for every tier.
- **Minimum age.** 192 calendar months is sixteen years, counted from the date of birth on the customer's profile; the same minimum applies to every tier.

## Worked illustrations (hypothetical figures)

| Hypothetical calendar-year qualifying spend | Highest threshold met |
|---|---|
| 349.99 | Marlowe Rewards Member (Silver needs 350.00) |
| 350.00 | Marlowe Rewards Silver |
| 1499.99 | Marlowe Rewards Gold (Platinum needs 1500.00) |
| 6000.00 | Marlowe Rewards Atelier |

A tier reached at any point in a hypothetical year 2025 is, by the validity column, valid through 31 December 2026.
